name: Data.reflectionSum_mul_e₀
summary: e0 is a sum of tensor products of label idempotents of good families; at the place i the label has no root with x^(M_omega) = 1, in particular not charName(chi), so the reflection sum kills that factor.

steps.claim: Expand e0(D) = sum over good families c of tupleIdem(RowIndex(D), c) and distribute the product; it suffices that piTensorElem(x) tupleIdem(RowIndex(D), c) = 0 for every c in goodTupleFamilies(D).
steps.lean:
(e : x i = reflectionSum χ l) : piTensorElem x * D.e₀ = 0 := by erw [mul_sum, sum_map,
  sum_eq_zero fun _ o ↦ piTensorElem_mul_eq_zero i (e ▸ reflectionSum_mul_labelIdem
  (((mem_filter.1 (Fintype.mem_piFinset.1 o _)).2.1 _).2 _ (charName_pow_eq_one hχ)) hl)]

steps.claim: For such c, the label c_i at the place i has no root x with x^(M_omega) = 1 (goodTuples), and charName(chi)^(M_omega) = 1 since chi^(M_omega) = 1; so charName(chi) is not a root of c_i and, l being nonzero, reflectionSum(chi, l) labelIdem(c_i) = 0. As x_i = reflectionSum(chi, l), the product of the tensor products vanishes at the factor i.
steps.lean:
sum_eq_zero fun _ o ↦ piTensorElem_mul_eq_zero i (e ▸ reflectionSum_mul_labelIdem
  (((mem_filter.1 (Fintype.mem_piFinset.1 o _)).2.1 _).2 _ (charName_pow_eq_one hχ)) hl)]
